affliction.description: This disease is capable of wiping out nations or even entire continents. A few pockets of the disease still remain in Iobaria, keeping that region’s population sparse.
affliction.name: Choking Death

stages.effect: hoarse voice but no other symptoms
stages.name: Stage 1

traits.name: Disease
traits.text: An effect with this trait applies one or more diseases. A disease is typically an affliction.
